announcements.text: General Dynamics Land Systems Inc., Sterling Heights, Michigan, was awarded a $332,500,000 cost-no-fee, cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for sustainment services for the Stryker family of vehicles, including total package fielding, deprocessing, new equipment training, and field-level maintenance support. Bids were solicited via the internet with three received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Nov. 17, 2031. Army Contracting Command, Detroit Arsenal, Michigan, is the contracting activity (W912CH-27-D-A111).

extracted.description: Sustainment services for the Stryker family of vehicles, including total package fielding, deprocessing, new equipment training, and field-level maintenance support

announcements.text: Sherpa 6 Inc.,* Littleton, Colorado, was awarded a $99,878,455 cost-no-fee, firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for a Small Business Innovation Research Phase III effort to demonstrate the utility of a unified endpoint management platform at the tactical edge. One bid was solicited with one received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Nov. 17, 2031. Army Contracting Command, Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland, is the contracting activity (W911QX-27-D-A001).

contracting_activity.name: Army Contracting Command, Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland

extracted.description: SBIR Phase III effort to demonstrate utility of a unified endpoint management platform at the tactical edge

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Co., Marietta, Georgia, has been awarded a $316,630,587 cost-plus-fixed-fee, cost-plus-incentive-fee, and firm-fixed-price indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for contract logistics support for the C-5 Galaxy. This contract provides supply chain management, repair, administration, management, and engineering investigative/technical support services. The work will be performed in Marietta, Georgia, and is expected to be completed by Nov. 30, 2031. This contract was a sole source acquisition. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $6,975,425; and Air Force working capital funds in the amount of $16,694,138 are being obligated at the time of award. The C-5 Contracting Branch, Robins Air Force Base, Georgia, is the contracting activity. (FA8525-27-D-B001)

announcements.text: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory, Laurel, Maryland, has been awarded a $24,999,860 cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00034) to a previously awarded contract (FA8650-23-C-9302) for engineering, management, technical and operational support to the Integrated Capabilities Directorate. This modification brings the total cumulative face value to $80,861,279. Work will be performed in Laurel, Maryland, and is expected to be completed by Sept. 30, 2027. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $1,560,000 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Research Laboratory, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Energetics Technology Center Inc., Indian Head, Maryland, is awarded an $11,156,378 modification to a previously awarded contract (N0017425C0041) to increase the ceiling for procurement of alternative designs for the government to utilize in prototype development of advanced warhead and fuzing concepts. Work will be performed in Indian Head, Maryland, and is expected to be completed by December 2030. No funding will be obligated at the time of award. Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division, Indian Head, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
